summary: The diff implements REQ-38 and REQ-39 as specified. A '+' increment button was added to ProductManagementTable with loading state and success toast. The useIncrementInventory hook was created in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts, and the backend now includes an incrementInventory method. The backend also introduced a migration module and added inventoryCount to the Product type. All acceptance criteria for both requirements appear to be satisfied.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module (backend/migration.mo) that transforms old product/cart/category structures to new structures without categories and with inventoryCount
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention data migration, schema changes, or removal of categories. The migration module removes categories entirely and adds inventoryCount = 0 as a default, which goes beyond the specified requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Removal of category-related code and fields from products, shopping carts, and UI components
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly states constraints to maintain existing functionality and does not authorize removal of categories. The diff removes category fields from Product type, removes category management from dashboard, removes category filters from marketplace, and eliminates all category-related UI elements.

hallucinated_features.description: Auto-copy toggle feature in BulkProductUpload that synchronizes fields from first item to all others
hallucinated_features.reason: This feature was not requested in the BuildRequest and appears unrelated to the inventory increment button requirement.
